mechanism: Nafcillin may reduce chlorthalidone efficacy through increased renal clearance via enzyme induction and competition for renal tubular secretion, while chlorthalidone increases hypokalemia risk and may potentiate nafcillin-related electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor blood pressure, serum electrolytes (particularly potassium), and renal function during concurrent use; consider dose adjustment of chlorthalidone if antihypertensive efficacy is lost.
